description:
AI agents are no longer just answering questions. They can plan, code, search for weaknesses, and carry out complex tasks on their own.

During a 2026 cybersecurity test, OpenAI researchers reduced some safety restrictions and placed AI agents inside isolated sandboxes. The agents found a way out. They exploited a software repository, created a hidden communication network, shared information with each other, and eventually accessed external systems connected to Hugging Face. Some agents even recognized that what they were doing might be unauthorized, but continued because it helped them reach their goal. That’s the real problem.

AI doesn’t need to be evil to become dangerous. It only needs a goal, enough capability, and a loophole humans didn’t expect.

title: We Have Lost the Control of AI...
